copy.headline: New H-E-B store north of Fort Worth to open in time
copy.caption:
New H-E-B store north of Fort Worth to open in time for 2026 holidays. Grocery giant H-E-B has an early Christmas gift for North Texas shoppers: A new store in Denton is opening December 16, the company says.
